test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest for an amount of Rs. 2,500 at 8 (1)/(4)% per annum for the period from 1st March 2018 to 12th May 2018.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,500

Rate (R) = 8¹/₄% per annum

Time (t) = 1st March 2018 to 12th May 2018

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times t}{100}

**Calculation:**

Time from 1st March 2018 to 12th May 2018 = 31 (March) + 30 (April) + 12 (May) = 73 days

⇒ t = dfrac{73}{365} years

⇒ t = dfrac{1}{5} years

Rate (R) = 8¹/₄% = 8.25%

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{2500 times 8.25 times dfrac{1}{5}}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{2500 times 8.25 times 0.2}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{41250}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹41.25

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
